title: 12 Best Bún Riêu in Hanoi (2026)
description: The best bún riêu (crab noodle soup) spots in Hanoi — curated from Reddit reviews, local blogs, and Google ratings. From Old Quarter classics to late-night haunts.

places.name: Bún Riêu Cô Hoàn Hàng Lược

redditQuotes.text: Many people often choose Mrs. Hoan's delicious bún riêu when they want a full, nutritious breakfast. A portion here is very large with many fillings such as pork, crab paste, beef, shrimp, snails and rolls.

places.verdict: The most-recommended bún riêu in Hanoi. Massive portions with pork, crab paste, beef, shrimp, snails, and rolls. Sells out by 9 AM — come early.

comparison.best for: Traditional full-loaded bún riêu with 7+ toppings
comparison.strengths: 4.3★ from 561 Google reviews · massive portions · consistent quality for decades
comparison.limitations: Closes by 9:00 AM — you must arrive early
comparison.why it made the list: Mentioned across VNGTours, VietnamNet, and multiple Reddit threads. The sheer variety of toppings — pork, crab, beef, shrimp, snails, spring rolls — makes each bowl a meal unto itself.
comparison.what to order: The full bowl (bún riêu thập cẩm) with all toppings. Add extra mắm tôm (shrimp paste) and lime.

places.whatToOrder: The full bowl (bún riêu thập cẩm) with all toppings. Add extra mắm tôm (shrimp paste) and lime.

places.editorialSummary: The most-recommended bún riêu in Hanoi. Massive portions with pork, crab paste, beef, shrimp, snails, and rolls. Sells out by 9 AM — come early.

places.name: Bún Riêu Tóp Mỡ Cô Hương Béo
places.address: 2c P. Tống Duy Tân, Hoàn Kiếm

redditQuotes.text: The restaurant's noodle soup stands out with a naturally sweet taste. The ingredients for making broth or toppings are carefully processed. The vermicelli is very soft, fresh and not at all sour or dry.

places.verdict: Famous for crispy pork crackling (tóp mỡ) and bouncy meatballs (mọc giòn) that add textural magic to every bowl. Open late — one of the few evening bún riêu options.

comparison.best for: Crispy pork crackling and bouncy meatball bún riêu
comparison.strengths: 4.4★ · unique tóp mỡ (pork crackling) · open until 11 PM · naturally sweet broth
comparison.limitations: Can get crowded; two locations (this one + Trần Xuân Soạn)
comparison.why it made the list: The tóp mỡ (pork crackling) is the star — crispy, golden, and deeply satisfying. VNGTours and VietnamNet both highlight the naturally sweet, non-sour broth and fresh, soft vermicelli.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu tóp mỡ mọc giòn (crab noodle soup with pork crackling and crispy meatballs). Extra shrimp paste on the side.

places.whatToOrder: Bún riêu tóp mỡ mọc giòn (crab noodle soup with pork crackling and crispy meatballs). Extra shrimp paste on the side.
places.insiderTip: The tóp mỡ (pork crackling) is the star — crispy, golden, and deeply satisfying. VNGTours and VietnamNet both highlight the naturally sweet, non-sour broth and fresh, soft vermicelli.
places.editorialSummary: Famous for crispy pork crackling (tóp mỡ) and bouncy meatballs (mọc giòn) that add textural magic to every bowl. Open late — one of the few evening bún riêu options.
places.bestFor: Crispy pork crackling and bouncy meatball bún riêu

places.name: Bún Riêu Hàng Bạc

redditQuotes.text: Featured in Le Figaro (France), Crab Noodle Soup at 11 Hang Bac Street is renowned for its rich broth and variety of side dishes, including snails, fried tofu, and crab roe.

places.verdict: Featured in Le Figaro (France) — an Old Quarter institution with a tangier, more aromatic broth than most competitors. The handmade daily crab paste makes the difference.

comparison.best for: International press-recognized Old Quarter bún riêu
comparison.strengths: Featured in Le Figaro · handmade daily crab paste · 6-hour broth · walkable from Hoàn Kiếm Lake
comparison.limitations: Small seating, can be crowded at lunch
comparison.why it made the list: VietnamNet, GTrip, and TasteAtlas all list this as one of the best bún riêu in Hanoi. The broth is simmered 6+ hours and the crab paste is made fresh daily.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu thập cẩm (mixed bowl) with snails, fried tofu, and crab roe. Ask for extra mắm tôm.

places.whatToOrder: Bún riêu thập cẩm (mixed bowl) with snails, fried tofu, and crab roe. Ask for extra mắm tôm.
places.insiderTip: VietnamNet, GTrip, and TasteAtlas all list this as one of the best bún riêu in Hanoi. The broth is simmered 6+ hours and the crab paste is made fresh daily.
places.editorialSummary: Featured in Le Figaro (France) — an Old Quarter institution with a tangier, more aromatic broth than most competitors. The handmade daily crab paste makes the difference.
places.bestFor: International press-recognized Old Quarter bún riêu

places.name: Bún Riêu Sườn Sụn Trang

redditQuotes.text: Trang's humble eatery has carved out a unique niche in Hanoi's bún riêu scene with its distinctively rich version featuring tender pork ribs and cartilage.

places.verdict: A unique niche in Hanoi's bún riêu scene — tender pork ribs and cartilage transform the classic crab broth into something heartier and more collagen-rich. Often sells out by early afternoon.

comparison.best for: Meaty, collagen-rich bún riêu with pork ribs
comparison.strengths: 4.2★ · unique pork rib + cartilage version · near Old Quarter · traditional low-stool seating
comparison.limitations: Sells out by early afternoon, especially weekends
comparison.why it made the list: GTrip ranks it #4 in Hanoi, calling it 'a unique niche in Hanoi's bún riêu scene.' The collagen-rich broth from slow-cooked pork ribs adds body that standard bún riêu can't match.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu sườn sụn (crab noodle soup with pork ribs and cartilage). The cartilage is cooked to a soft, chewy texture.

places.whatToOrder: Bún riêu sườn sụn (crab noodle soup with pork ribs and cartilage). The cartilage is cooked to a soft, chewy texture.
places.insiderTip: GTrip ranks it #4 in Hanoi, calling it 'a unique niche in Hanoi's bún riêu scene.' The collagen-rich broth from slow-cooked pork ribs adds body that standard bún riêu can't match.

places.name: Bún Riêu Huyền Thu

redditQuotes.text: Bun Rieu Huyen Thu has become a culinary landmark for locals and food-savvy travelers seeking authentic Hanoi flavors. For over 20 years, locals have trusted Huyen Thu for its unwavering quality.

places.verdict: GTrip's #1 pick — over 20 years of unwavering quality. Pricier than street stalls but the generous crab paste, meticulously arranged herb basket, and perfectly balanced tomato broth justify every đồng.

comparison.best for: The premium, sit-down bún riêu experience with curated herb basket
comparison.strengths: 20+ year legacy · GTrip #1 · generous crab paste · clean ambiance · diverse herb selection
comparison.limitations: Higher price (65,000–90,000 VND) · mixed Google rating (3.7★)
comparison.why it made the list: GTrip, VietnamNet, and VNGTours all rank it as a top pick. The herb basket — banana blossoms, water morning glory, Vietnamese balm, perilla leaves, lime — elevates the experience.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu đặc biệt (special bowl) with full toppings. Use all the herbs from the garnish basket — each one adds a distinct layer.

places.whatToOrder: Bún riêu đặc biệt (special bowl) with full toppings. Use all the herbs from the garnish basket — each one adds a distinct layer.

places.name: Bún Riêu Bề Bề Tây Hồ (Mantis Shrimp)
places.address: 608 Đ. Lạc Long Quân, Tây Hồ

redditQuotes.text: The mantis shrimp adds both textural contrast and a uniquely sweet flavor profile that separates this establishment from other bún riêu vendors across Hanoi.

places.verdict: The most unusual bún riêu on this list — mantis shrimp replaces the traditional crab, creating a uniquely sweet, oceanic broth. Worth the trip to the West Lake district.

comparison.best for: Adventurous eaters wanting a unique mantis shrimp twist on bún riêu
comparison.strengths: Unique mantis shrimp variation · 6-hour broth · family-run for generations · near West Lake
comparison.limitations: Higher price (100,000 VND) · outside Old Quarter (Tây Hồ district)
comparison.why it made the list: GTrip #2 pick. The mantis shrimp adds textural contrast and a uniquely sweet flavor that separates it from every other bún riêu in the city. The family has preserved their recipe for generations.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu bề bề (mantis shrimp crab noodle soup). Add extra mantis shrimp topping (+30,000 VND) — it's worth it.

places.whatToOrder: Bún riêu bề bề (mantis shrimp crab noodle soup). Add extra mantis shrimp topping (+30,000 VND) — it's worth it.

places.name: Thu Bún Riêu (Thọ Xương Alley)

redditQuotes.text: Nestled in Tho Xuong Alley, Thu Crab Noodle Soup may be unassuming, but its flavors have garnered international attention, even featuring on CNN.

places.verdict: Nestled in Thọ Xương Alley, this unassuming spot has been featured on CNN. The flavors have garnered international attention despite — or because of — its humble sidewalk setting.

comparison.best for: Budget-friendly, CNN-featured alleyway bún riêu experience
comparison.strengths: Featured on CNN · excellent value · authentic alleyway setting · near Hoàn Kiếm Lake
comparison.limitations: Very basic seating · can be hard to find in the alley
comparison.why it made the list: International media recognition (CNN), rock-bottom prices, and a bowl packed with crab soup, fried tofu, blanched beef, snails, and duck eggs.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu thập cẩm (fully loaded bowl). Traditional or fully loaded — both deliver authentic flavors.

places.name: Bún Riêu Tóp Tê Hương Béo (Trần Xuân Soạn)
places.address: 57 P. Trần Xuân Soạn, Hai Bà Trưng

redditQuotes.text: Experience the nostalgic flavors of bún riêu cua tóp tê. The broth is the star, boasting a sour, light taste accentuated by pureed tomatoes and fermented vinegar.

places.verdict: The original Hương Béo location — known for tóp tê (crispy, golden pork crackling) that perfectly complements the sour-light broth with pureed tomatoes and fermented vinegar.

comparison.best for: Nostalgic bún riêu cua tóp tê with crispy golden crackling
comparison.strengths: 292 Google reviews · signature tóp tê · lighter, more sour broth · all-day hours
comparison.limitations: Outside Old Quarter (Hai Bà Trưng district) · 3.6★ rating
comparison.why it made the list: VietnamNet calls it a must-try, highlighting the nostalgic flavors and the crispy golden tóp tê that creates a delightful harmony with the broth.
comparison.what to order: Bún riêu cua tóp tê — the crispy crackling is the star. The lighter, more sour broth is intentional and pairs perfectly.

places.name: Bún Riêu Phố Cổ (Hàng Cót)

places.verdict: The cheapest bún riêu on this list — bowls start at just 20,000 VND ($0.80). Run by a native Hanoian for decades, the traditional flavor profile is authentic and uncompromising.

comparison.limitations: Morning only (closes 11 AM) · 3.4★ rating · basic seating
comparison.why it made the list: VNGTours highlights the rich riêu-flavored broth and delicious shrimp paste. The menu clearly lists prices and fillings — transparent and budget-friendly.
comparison.what to order: Start with the basic bowl (20,000 VND) and add toppings à la carte. The shrimp paste here is particularly good.
